The test cases in this folder are from the W3C OWL 2 Test Case Repository
(https://www.w3.org/2009/11/owl-test/), the approved test cases of the W3C OWL Working Group
described in OWL 2 Web Ontology Language Conformance (https://www.w3.org/TR/owl2-conformance/).

W3C test suites are covered by the dual-licensing approach described in
[LICENSES FOR W3C TEST SUITES](https://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/2008/04-testsuite-copyright.html):
they are distributed under both the
[W3C Test Suite License](https://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/2008/04-testsuite-license) and the
[W3C 3-clause BSD License](https://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/2008/03-bsd-license).
